In King's Indian Attack: Pachman System, relate it to this course objective: Meet Nf3 with d5, challenge White's center, and develop into the recognizable King's Indian Attack structure before starting counterplay. Before copying it against another reply, check for forcing captures, checks, central breaks, and king safety; those details decide whether the same plan still works.
